PB-Rib

Metal Roofing and Cladding

PB-Rib (Purlin Bearing Rib) commercial grade metal roofing and cladding is the perfect choice when you need strength and durability beyond that of other panels. Proven strength, extraordinary outdoor corrosion resistance and longevity make PB-Rib perfect for industrial, commercial and agricultural applications.

Specifications

  • 26 and 24 gauge Hi-Tensile steel 
  • Standard lengths from 4′ to 40′
  • Comes in a wide choice of attractive colours or Galvanized and Galvalume material
  • Low slope capability to 1/12
  • Built to withstand extreme snow loads
  • Purlin bearing leg design makes panel alignment and fastener engagement easy and consistent
